Make evidence from a plain table

Source: R/flode_evidence.R
as_flode_evidence.Rd

Turns a data.frame or data.table into a FlodeEvidence, keeping every column it already has and filling the rest. Only stage_m and discharge_cms are required. The fill is deliberately plain, and the result says what it assumed in its conversion_note:

  • evidence_id is generated as G001, G002 and so on, in row order.

  • observation_time is taken from gauging_datetime when that column exists, and is otherwise NA.

  • source_type is "gauging", included is TRUE, weight is 1 and source_row is the row position.

  • The text columns are NA, and metadata is empty for each row.

A table that is already a FlodeEvidence is returned as it is.

Usage

as_flode_evidence(x)

Arguments

x

A data.frame, data.table or FlodeEvidence.

Value

A FlodeEvidence.

See also

FlodeEvidence(), evidence_source_types()

Examples

plain <- data.frame(stage_m = c(0.5, 1.1, 1.8), discharge_cms = c(1.2, 5.1, 12.4))
evidence <- as_flode_evidence(plain)
evidence$evidence_id
#> [1] "G001" "G002" "G003"
evidence@conversion_note
#> [1] "Converted from a plain table; filled evidence_id, site_id, observation_time, source_type, source_name, source_version, quality_code, exclusion_reason, notes, included, weight, source_row, metadata. source_type assumed 'gauging', included assumed TRUE, weight assumed 1."
